id: FR-001
type: FR
title: "A requirement with a property-shaped criterion"
---

## Description

The parser SHALL round-trip every document it accepts.

## Acceptance Criteria

| ID | Criteria | Verification |
|----|----------|--------------|
| FR-001-AC-1 | Every parsed document serializes back to its input byte-for-byte. | Test (TC-001) |
| FR-001-AC-2 | The system shall handle it appropriately. | Test (TC-002) |
